name: Cosmic Manifestations
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card and select a system adjacent to your home system that contains no planets. Replace that system tile with a randomly drawn red-backed tile. Purge that replaced tile. If the new system contains no planets, place a frontier token in it.

name: Filibustered Legislation
text: When an agenda is resolved, you may exhaust this card. That agenda is resolved with no effect. Each player may ready 1 planet they control. During the agenda phase in which this effect is used, vote on 1 additional agenda.

name: Lost Throne
text: When you gain this breakthrough, place the Aurelion station token in a system that contains a planet you control. Then, flip this card.

name: Prototype Innovators
text: During each round of combat, or when you would roll dice for a unit ability, you may treat up to 3 units you control for which you own the corresponding unit upgrade technology as if they were galvanized.

name: Relic Trading Hub
text: When you gain this breakthrough and at the start of each strategy phase, shuffle each relic on this card back into the relic deck. Then, draw 3 relics and place them on this card. After a player gains a relic, you may exhaust this card to purge that relic and give that player 1 relic on this card.

name: Remote Workforce
text: When you resolve a unit's PRODUCTION ability, you may exhaust this card to resolve the PRODUCTION abilities of each unit you control in another system. Increase the combined PRODUCTION of those units by 2.

name: Revenant Rising
text: When you gain this breakthrough and each time you score a secret objective, you may draw 1 random unused agent and attach it to this card. This card has the ability text of each agent attached to it. Once per game round, when you would exhaust this card, you may purge 1 agent attached to this card instead.

name: Royal Rail Gun
text:
If you own a PDS unit upgrade technology, flip this card and place it in your play area. Your PDS units gain the following ability text; adjust their printed values by the indicated amounts. If they do not have those values, they gain them.

Back Side: This unit is also a ground force and a ship and may be transported by a ship with capacity.
Combat: 5
SUSTAIN DAMAGE

name: Self-Destruct Button
text: At the start of a combat, you may exhaust this card and destroy 1 non-fighter ship you control in that system to produce a number of hits equal to that unit's cost.

name: Subjugate
text: ACTION: Exhaust this card and spend 3 influence to return 1 other player's command token from the game board to their reinforcements. Then, perform a tactical action in a non-home system without spending a command token.

name: Twilight Defense Systems
text: Planets that contain your space docks or mechs gain PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON 6 as if they were units. These planets may use their SPACE CANNON abilities against ships in adjacent systems. Other players' abilities cannot cause your units to lose PLANETARY SHIELD.

name: Unyielding Accord
text:
When 1 or more other players place a command token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control, ready 1 planet in that system and explore it.
ACTION: Exhaust this card and select 1 player who has passed. That player places 1 of their command tokens in a system that contains your units and none of their command tokens.

name: Power Word: Wish
text: When you gain this breakthrough, choose a side for it to start on. When you research a propulsion or warfare technology, flip this card. When you activate a system, you may apply +1 to the move value of 1 unit you control and +2 to the combat value of 2 units you control during that tactical action.

name: Power Word: Wish
text: When you research a cybernetic or biotic technology, flip this card. When you activate a system, apply +1 to the capacity value of 2 units until the end of that tactical action. When you use PRODUCTION, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.

name: Training Programs
text:
When you spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of another player's strategy card, you may place 1 infantry from that player's reinforcements on a planet that contains your ground forces. You may either resolve ground combat on that planet or place that infantry into coexistence.
Once per action, when you win a ground combat, gain 2 commodities.

name: Compactor
text:
When 1 or more of your non-fighter ships are destroyed, you may place them on this card.
ACTION: Exhaust this card and return any number of units on this card to their reinforcements. Gain trade goods equal to half their combined cost (rounded down).

name: Refragment Dormant
text:
**UNLEASH**: Remove 2 Fragmentum tokens of the same color from your faction sheet.

ACTION: Purge 1 relic fragment from your play area. Then, you may gain 1 purged relic fragment of any other color.

name: Refragment Unleashed
text: ACTION: Purge 1 relic fragment from your play area. Then, you may gain 2 purged relic fragments of any other color.

name: Metamorphic Transference
text:
When you negotiate a transaction, action cards in either player's hand or on this card may be exchanged as part of that transaction.
When you win a combat, place the top card of the action card deck face up on this card.

name: Neurografting
text:
When your units enter coexistence with another player’s units, you may exhaust this card to research 1 technology owned by that player.
When another player ends coexistence with your units, you may ready this card.
